title: Phil Tippett Documentary Trailer
content: Here's a trailer (Link to YouTube) for a new documentary on stop motion animator Phil Tippett, who animated the Tauntauns and the Imperial walkers for Star Wars.Since the CGI revolution, he has been working on personal projects such as Mad God (Link to YouTube) that extend the possibilities of stop motion in visualizing strange dreams. and equally strange and suggestive CGI / practical hybrids such asMutant Land.
